draw_baseline_heatmap: draw a heatmap of baseline tensor data with normal and log10 scales
draw_target_heatmap: draw a heatmap of target tensor data with normal and log10 scales
draw_diff_heatmap: draw a heatmap of absolute differences between baseline and target tensors
draw_diff_histogram: draw a histogram of absolute differences with normal and log10 scales
draw_hist2d: draw a 2D histogram comparing baseline and target tensor values
